teach.goal: Ponte português → inglês com palavras úteis.
solo: Peça uma frase pessoal com 2 das palavras.
group: Palavras: slice, recommend, plain, pie, certainly, bill.
Aluno diz em português um uso real, depois a palavra em inglês.
extra90: Cada aluno escolhe a palavra mais útil e explica por quê.

facts.label: Would you like…?
facts.sub: Use Would you like + coisa ou to + verbo para oferecer. Responda Yes, please ou No, thank you, e peça com I’d like…, please.

facts.label: Gostaria de…?
facts.sub: Use Would you like + coisa para oferecer: Would you like some tea? Use Would you like to + verbo para oferecer uma ação: Would you like to see the menu? Fica educado e leve.

facts.label: Eu gostaria de…
facts.sub: Use I’d like + coisa para pedir: I’d like some water, please. É mais educado que I want. I’d é a forma curta de I would. Termine com please para soar mais gentil.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Would you like… is a polite offer.
Would you like means What is your name?
I’d like is a polite way to ask for something.
items.why: Yes, I’d like = I would like.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Would you like… is a polite offer. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Would you like means What is your name? → Falso (It is an offer.)
I’d like is a polite way to ask for something. → Verdadeiro (Yes, I’d like = I would like.)

pages.title: A restaurant in Atlanta · 1/3
paragraphs: Marco has dinner in a warm restaurant in Atlanta. The main dish was very good. Dee is the waitress at his table. She is polite and quick. Now it is time for dessert. Marco is happy and a little hungry.
“Good evening. Would you like to see the dessert menu?” says Dee. “Yes, please. What do you recommend?” says Marco. “The peach pie is our favorite. Would you like a slice with ice cream?” says Dee.
